from itertools import permutations

def is_costas_array(x):
    """Check if a permutation is a Costas array."""
    n = len(x)
    vectors = set()
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i+1, n):
            dr = x[j] - x[i]
            dc = j - i
            if (dr, dc) in vectors:
                return False
            vectors.add((dr, dc))
    return True
